stats.label: Delivery statistics

info.successRate: Succeeded ÷ (succeeded + failed) for deliveries created in the range. Deliveries still retrying are not counted.
info.deliveries: Deliveries created in the range. An event sent to N subscriptions counts N times.
info.failed: Deliveries created in the range whose current status is failed. Resending a delivery updates the count.
info.disabledSubscriptions: Subscriptions disabled right now, manually or automatically. Not affected by the range.

stats.refreshFailed: Couldn't refresh the statistics. Showing the last loaded data.
stats.currentCountBasis: Subscriptions disabled right now. Not affected by the range.
stats.retryingBasis: {{count}} more deliveries are still retrying and are not counted as failed.
stats.noComparisonBasis: The previous range is older than the delivery log retention, so there is nothing to compare with.
stats.vsPreviousBasis: vs the same point of the previous {{days}} days

filter.searchDeliveries: Search by event ID or type...

action.sendTestDisabled: Enable the subscription to send a test event

disabledReason.consecutiveFailures: Disabled automatically after failing continuously since {{time}}

subscriptions.previousSecret: The previous secret also signs until {{time}}
subscriptions.emptyHint: Create a subscription to push events to another system

deliveries.emptyHint: Deliveries appear here once events are published

sheet.title: Delivery details
sheet.description: The request sent for this event and every attempt to deliver it.

dialog.description: Choose the events to push. A signing secret is generated on save and shown only once.
dialog.headerIncomplete: Each header needs both a name and a value.
dialog.headersHint: Sent with every request. webhook-* and Content-Type are set by the system.

field.name: Name
field.urlHint: An absolute http(s) URL. Private network addresses are blocked when sending.

secret.onlyOnce: It cannot be viewed again after closing. Hand it to the receiver now.
secret.createdHint: Receivers verify requests with a Standard Webhooks library and deduplicate by {{header}}.
secret.rotatedHint: The previous secret keeps signing alongside this one for a transition period. Update the receiver before it ends.

enable.message: "{{name}}" starts receiving new events. Events that occurred while it was disabled are not sent.
enable.retryFailedHint: Each failed delivery still in the log is resent once.

confirm.rotateMessage: A new secret is generated now. The previous secret keeps signing alongside it for a transition period, so receivers can switch without dropping requests.
confirm.disableMessage: Deliveries waiting to be retried are marked as failed, and events that occur while it is disabled are not sent later.
confirm.deleteMessage: Delete "{{name}}"? Its delivery log is deleted with it and no longer counts in statistics.
